description: Labeled evaluation set for the COME-BACK detector (issue #30 point 6). Ground truth is INDEPENDENT of the detector's trend/break logic: each game's lead series was folded from mvd-api getEvents frag deltas (the fold is validated exact against overview team totals — fold_ok) and labeled by the eventual winner's worst deficit. 'comeback' = the winner overcame a 16+ frag deficit; 'control' = the winner never trailed by more than 7 (wire-to-wire / steady game, no comeback happened). Demos pull from the d.quake.world CDN via mvd-api POST /v1/demos/gameId:<hub_game_id> (cold sha-loads 404 — Phase-1 finding); once cached, sha loads work.
selection_notes: Positives/controls sourced from the 5 cached state/demos plus a Turso sweep (scripts/selection/turso_query.py) of 4on4 games: close finals (abs(score1-score2) <= 10) screened as comeback candidates, blowouts (>= 60) as control candidates, every pick then verified via the mvd-api lead series. Excluded: 8d8d69cc... (winner overcame only 11 — ambiguous, neither label), fb53c3b5... (3 team names in overview — detector requires 2), 5b284714... (lead-fold/overview mismatch, fold_ok=False — unreliable ground truth).
